{{samename|Poké Ball known as Dark Ball in Japanese|Dusk Ball}} ----- [[File:Dark Ball.png|250px|thumb|A Dark Ball]] A '''Dark Ball''' (Japanese: '''ダークボール''' ''Dark Ball'') is a [[Poké Ball]] variation that was featured in ''[[M04|Celebi: The Voice of the Forest]]''. Similar to the "[[Mewtwo Balls]]" from ''[[M01|Mewtwo Strikes Back]]'', Dark Balls are able to {{pkmn2|caught|catch}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that already belong to a {{pkmn|Trainer}}, as opposed to catching [[wild Pokémon]] only. ==History== The only person who has been seen using a Dark Ball is the [[Iron-Masked Marauder]]. He claimed that any {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} {{pkmn2|caught|captured}} with a Dark Ball will become evil and their power will increase to the highest [[level]]. The Pokémon loses its freedom and will [[obedience|obey]] all commands of its master. The Iron-Masked Marauder used a Dark Ball to capture a {{p|Tyranitar}} owned by a [[Pokémon hunter|Pokémon poacher]] and bring it under his control, even though it already belonged to someone. Later, he caught a {{OBP|Celebi|M04}} in a Dark Ball as well. The control of a Dark Ball can be fought and even broken if the Pokémon has enough willpower. Should this happen, the Dark Ball that captured it will be destroyed. This happened to Celebi after it had been captured by Iron-Masked Marauder, although it nearly lost its life in the process. Conversely, if a Dark Ball is destroyed, the Pokémon it was used to capture will be freed from its influence and return to its normal state (as happened with the Marauder's other three Pokémon). ==Trivia== * Pokémon captured with the Dark Ball have similar characteristics to [[Shadow Pokémon]], which in Japanese are called {{j|ダークポケモン}}, Dark Pokémon. Both Shadow Pokémon and Pokémon captured with Dark Balls supposedly have their power increased and both are described as being "soulless". * The Pokémon who are caught with Dark Balls seem to have their skin color darkened. Celebi is the exception, instead developing a blank, lifeless expression with narrowed pupils. * The [[Dusk Ball]] introduced in {{game|Diamond and Pearl|s}} is called the Dark Ball in Japanese, but the name was changed in localizations. ==In other languages== {{langtable|color={{dark color light}}|bordercolor={{dark color}} |zh_yue=漆黑球 ''{{tt|Chāthāk Kàuh|Dark Ball}}'' |zh_cmn=黑暗球 ''{{tt|Hēi'àn Qiú|Dark Ball}}'' {{tt|*|Official Website}}
